capabilities: record voice notes from a mic button or command
transcribe recordings using Whisper, Groq or Deepgram
apply custom AI prompts to transcriptions
embed audio files and outputs as callouts in notes
retry transcription of saved audio files after failures
extras: README includes detailed API key setup steps and notes that transcription providers require billing information on the account.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record voice notes, transcribe them, or run AI prompts on the transcription inside a note.
